skills.description: Turn a Figma frame into a complete, no-questions-asked developer spec packet. Pulls layout, tokens, states, breakpoints, edge cases and a11y notes from the frame and renders them as a single Markdown file that links back to the Figma node.
trigger_intents: Need to hand a Figma frame to engineering
Need a complete spec packet from a design
Need a deterministic developer-facing spec
do_not_use_for: Critiquing whether a design is good
skills.breaking_risks_summary: Read-only extraction and synthesis. Primary risk is invented tokens or hallucinated states, mitigated by strict procedure forbidding non-resolved values.

skills.name: token-mapping-audit
skills.description: For a given Figma frame, list every raw colour, spacing, radius, type and shadow value, map each one to a DS token via Token MCP, flag values with no token match, and recommend the closest semantic token.
trigger_intents: Need to audit token usage in a Figma frame
Need to find unmapped values in a design
Need to verify a frame uses semantic tokens not foundation/palette
skills.breaking_risks_summary: Read-only audit. Primary risk is silent token mismatch, mitigated by surfacing all match candidates above threshold.

skills.name: state-matrix
skills.description: Generate the full interactive state grid for a Figma component (default, hover, focus-visible, active, disabled, loading, error, empty) with the token controlling the difference in each cell.

Need to verify all interactive states are implemented

skills.breaking_risks_summary: Read-only extraction. Primary risk is misclassifying a state, mitigated by the explicit `unknown` bucket and human-review surfacing.

skills.name: design-critique
skills.description: Structured critique of a Figma frame against Design System rules. Covers visual hierarchy, spacing rhythm, alignment, density, component reuse and channel fit. Returns a categorised findings list with node IDs.

Need findings on hierarchy, spacing, alignment, density, reuse, channel fit
skills.breaking_risks_summary: Read-only critique. Primary risk is subjective findings, mitigated by every rule pointing to a specific DS artefact or convention.

skills.name: a11y-check
skills.description: Design-time accessibility audit for a Figma frame. Checks colour contrast, text size, hit target size, focus indicator design, alt text placeholders, screen reader notes, and reduced-motion intent. Complements react/accessibility which covers WCAG 2.1 AA in implementation.

Need contrast, hit target, focus indicator audit on a frame
Need to verify a11y notes before handoff
skills.breaking_risks_summary: Read-only audit. Errors here are hard gates for handoff. Primary risk is missing context (decorative vs meaningful images), mitigated by requiring layer-name semantic intent.

skills.name: content-style-check
skills.description: Run the copy in a Figma frame against the Design System content styleguide. Checks voice, tone, British English, brand name usage, em dash avoidance, headline structure, table label rules, and typography token description format.

Need to enforce the Design System content styleguide

skills.breaking_risks_summary: Read-only audit. Heuristic findings (passive voice, jargon) marked warning/info to avoid false-positive errors.

skills.name: channel-context

Need to confirm channel tokens flow correctly through semantic layer

skills.name: spec-packet
